job.job_description:
We are seeking a motivated Back-End Developer to join our expanding team. You will have a pivotal role in building and maintaining the server-side logic of our applications, ensuring seamless integration with front-end elements. Your curiosity and willingness to embrace new technologies will be key as you work across a range of projects and platforms.

Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain robust server-side applications using Python and Node.js.
Build and optimize RESTful APIs for data exchange between front-end and back-end.
Work with SQL (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB) to design schemas and implement efficient data storage and retrieval strategies.
Collaborate with front-end developers to seamlessly integrate user interfaces with back-end services.
Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and knowledge sharing.
Embrace new technologies and frameworks to continuously improve our products.
Qualifications
Bachelor s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.
0-3 years of experience developing back-end applications with Python and/or Node.js.
Strong understanding of database design principles and experience working with both SQL and NoSQL databases.
Familiarity with RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.
A passion for learning, solving problems, and working in a team environment.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Nice to Have
Experience with cloud platforms like AWS or Azure.
Knowledge of DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
Familiarity with frontend technologies (React, Angular, Vue.js) is a plus.
job.location: New Delhi, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, Chennai, Hyderabad, Mumbai
